what_happened: The operator accepted the plan for job 20261024-115923-02gf. The plan's landing check (pr_commits in land.rs) requires exactly one Athena-Job trailer on every commit between the remote base and the PR head. The operator's own commits (lease renewals, BRIEF relays, decisions) and declared interventions carry no such trailer. So `athena land --pr` refused every pull request from commit 29fdd4c on, starting with job 20261024-114125-7z2t. The check also reads commit-message trailers, which Sri had asked not to depend on.
cause: Plan review has no required realistic fixture for checks that walk commit ranges. Reviewers judge the plan against the happy path of job-only commits. Nothing tells them that operator commits, records-only commits and interventions share the same branch range. A recorded owner constraint (no dependence on commit-message trailers) was also not checked against the design.
prevention: Require that any plan or change to landing or history checks come with a test whose fixture is built from this repository's real recent PR ranges. The fixture must include operator-path commits, records-only commits and declared interventions between base and head. The plan critic should reject the plan unless that test passes. The critic should also check the design against recorded owner constraints, such as not relying on commit-message trailers.
proposed_request: Fix `athena land --pr` so it no longer refuses pull requests that contain commits without an Athena-Job trailer (operator lease renewals, BRIEF relays, decisions, declared interventions). The landing check must not depend on commit-message trailers. Add a test that replays real recent PR ranges from this repository, starting at 29fdd4c. The test must show that a range mixing job commits, records-only commits, owner-path commits and interventions lands, and that job 20261024-114125-7z2t's pull request is accepted. Also require plan reviewers to run landing and history checks against such a realistic branch fixture before accepting a plan.
